The '''Mercantile Plaza''' was a trading platform constructed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]], [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Devastation of Manaan|attack]] on the world. The Plaza was the first surface structure constructed by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] after the attack, and was the result of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of negotiations between the Selkath and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Mahreen]]. The Plaza consisted of two platforms&mdash;the [[Imperial Concourse]] and the [[Republic Concourse]].
